tooltip-save-notes: Write the notes on the map.

tooltip-x: Blocks east of the world spawn (negative: west), like the coordinates display.

tooltip-save-waypoint: Draw the waypoint on the map.

gamemechanicinfo-maps-text:
Maps
Immersive Maps - Woeful_Wolf

Maps are a simple way to orient yourself and understand your surroundings.

There are two tiers of maps, the higher the tier, the larger the area it can cover.
The first and easiest map to obtain is the papyrus map. The second is the parchment map.

Be aware, a map will be centered on your current location the moment you hold it for the very first time.
Do not worry though, a map can be updated anytime by simply holding a drawing tool in your offhand, and pressing rightmouse. The easiest to obtain being the charcoal pencil and later a penner and inkhorn (no recipe yet) which has increased durability.
It can also update continuously as you move around!

You might seem a bit disoriented when charting a new map, this is normal, true north isn't something you can feel in your bones after all (well, at least I hope not).
You can luckily rotate a map in your hands at any time by pressing map-rotate-hk for clockwise rotation or map-rotate-reverse-hk for counter-clockwise rotation.

This is all well and good, but what good is a map without some waypoints? You can't remember where you saw that surface copper deposit 3000 blocks away, can you?
By pressing map-waypoints-gui you can manage the waypoints of the map you are holding. Adding new waypoints, or editing existing waypoints, requires a drawing tool in your offhand as well.

You can mark the coordinates found in letters on your map as well. Simply hold the map in your offhand when interacting with a letter to add it as a waypoint.

Out prospecting? Every reading of your prospecting pick comes with an "Add to your map" link in the chat. With your map in hand and a drawing tool in your offhand, click it to mark the spot.

Tired of redrawing? Craft any map together with a temporal gear to make it a temporal map. It stays centered on whoever holds it and follows them wherever they go.
